acceptanceCriteria: A test proves a quoted -run 'A|B' verify line is accepted or refused with a refusal that names the accepted form.
body: Observed 2026-10-21 in lane taskscli-1021r (PR #1499): dogfood-finish refused before running anything because the verify file had a -run regex alternation. Expected: a quoted regex argument is accepted, or the refusal names the accepted form (one -run per command). Workaround: split commands.
